prior.note: Spec L38-L43 defines the hazard tests and orbit bounds, but multiple asteroids can qualify at the first predicted point without a selection rule. The orbit rule also gives no correction when the ship is inside or outside ORBIT_R; turning controls the ship's heading, while velocity changes through flight physics (physics.ts:L25-L54). The plan still has to choose materially different steering behavior.

Spec L66-L70 selects the asteroid nearest the enemy after the contact tick. A tick can damage the ship against more than one asteroid: contacts.ts:L43-L45 increments asteroidHits for each damaging contact and moves the ship after each collision (contacts.ts:L9-L19). The final position and aggregate counter do not identify every asteroid struck, so bait attribution remains unreliable. Track the per-body graceUntil changes or emit contact events.
